title: Plus Membership Rates on the Northgate Tire Center Claim Fitting Charge
content:
# Plus membership rates on the claim fitting charge

**Schedule.** The Northgate Tire Center claim fitting charge — the charge for fitting a tire replaced under the treadwear mileage warranty — carries a member rate read from the Northgate Memberships record of the membership whose card was presented on the tires' purchase:

| Membership presented on the tires' purchase | Tenure to the claim entry | Member rate on the claim fitting charge |
|---|---|---|
| Plus tier | at least 120 months | 0.5 |
| Plus tier | below 120 months | 0.75 |
| not a Plus tier | any | 1 — the full rate, no reduction |

## Terms of the schedule

- **Which membership.** The purchase on which the tires were bought names the membership whose card was presented; that membership's own record in Northgate Memberships decides the rate, not any other membership the member holds.
- **Plus tier.** A membership is a Plus tier when it carries a Plus premium above zero.
- **Tenure.** The whole calendar months from the membership's opened date to the service date of the claim entry — the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package. A month counts once its day of the month is reached.
- **How the rate acts.** The claim fitting charge is multiplied by the member rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary of the 120-month tenure (hypothetical dates)

| Membership opened | Claim entry dated | Whole months | Rate for a Plus tier membership |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2016-05-10 | 2026-05-10 | 120 | 0.5 |
| 2016-05-10 | 2026-05-09 | 119 | 0.75 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A fitting charge of $30.00 before this rate, on a Plus tier membership with 80 months of tenure, is multiplied by 0.75, giving $22.50. On a membership that is not a Plus tier the same $30.00 is multiplied by 1 and stays $30.00.
